correctness.rationale: The implication is correct. Pullback restricts monodromy to a subgroup of the seed image, and Schlesinger transformations do not convert a finite projective monodromy image into an infinite one. Boalch explicitly proves that the Klein solution is not equivalent to a solution coming from a finite subgroup of SL_2(C); the package's order-7/noncommutation argument is a compatible elementary projective-group check.
